title: Matchstick puzzles
lead: Move one match so the equation becomes correct, or so you get the largest or the smallest number. Some puzzles have several answers.
keys: Keyboard: Tab or the arrow keys pick a match or a spot, Enter or Space lifts and places a match, Esc cancels.
task.fix: Move one match to make the equation correct.
task.max: Move one match to get the largest possible number.
task.min: Move one match to get the smallest possible number.
lifted: Match lifted. Pick an empty spot to put it in, or press it again to cancel.
okMore: Correct! You got **{result}**. Found {found} of {total}: try to find another answer.
okAll: Correct! You got **{result}**. You found all the answers ({total}).
dup: You already found this answer (**{result}**). Try to find another.
wrong.figure: Not quite: that shape is not a digit or a sign.
wrong.equation: Not quite: **{result}**. The equation is wrong.
wrong.zero: Not quite: **{result}**. A number can’t start with zero.
wrong.notmax: Not quite: **{result}**. That is not the largest possible number.
wrong.notmin: Not quite: **{result}**. That is not the smallest possible number.
hintMsg: 💡 The match you need to move is highlighted. Where to put it is up to you.
revealed: Answer: **{answer}**. Showing the answer does not count as solving the puzzle.
